config.claim: Development-only BM25 lexical lower-bound Stage 3 baseline. Deterministic Okapi BM25 over process action labels; normalized scores in [0,1]; matching evaluated primarily by ranking AP/MAP; binary rule (score > tau) pre-registered, never tuned on the 58-item Gold. Not a semantic method; no pretrained embeddings.

method.tokenizer: lowercase alphanumeric tokens (no stopword removal: lexical lower bound)

bm25.note: Okapi BM25 defaults; fixed in config, not tuned

method.normalization: score / max_possible(query) so results lie in [0,1]
method.matching_formula: matching_score = max(avg best rule-action BM25, avg best rule-actor BM25)
method.violation_semantics: mapping mirrors Sun Definitions 5-7 structure but with BM25 similarity; mappings do NOT depend on gamma/theta, so gamma/theta sensitivity is a legitimate score-cutoff re-derivation
method.empty_semantics: empty query/corpus -> score 0.0, no match, never silently compliant

thresholds.note: pre-registered on the method's lexical semantics (overlap must exceed half the maximum possible score); fixed sweeps reported separately, primary values never selected from Gold

inputs.note: runner reads ONLY the inference pack; no decision/candidate/evidence fields

evaluator.note: same common evaluator and same 58 item IDs as Winter/Sun
